title: Topology-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Wind-Field Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.22262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific super-resolution (SR) models are typically optimized with pointwise reconstruction losses, yet scientific interpretation often hinges on extrema, connected regions, and multiscale scalar structure. We characterize this tension with pretrained CNN and GAN wind-field SR models. Pointwise metrics, bottleneck persistence-diagram (PD) distance, and merge-tree (MT) distance favor the CNN, whereas order-2 Wasserstein PD distances favor the sharper GAN, so even different distances on the same topological descriptor reward different properties. Motivated by this disagreement, we fine-tune the pretrained CNN with differentiable topology-inspired auxiliary losses on scalar speed, gradient magnitude, soft high-speed level sets, and local maxima, and with fixed-pair supervision, which constrains predicted values and persistence at ground-truth persistence-pair endpoints located offline with the Topology ToolKit. translated_title: 拓扑启发的风场超分辨率微调方法
translated_abstract: 科学超分辨率（SR）模型通常使用逐点重建损失进行优化，然而科学解释往往依赖于极值、连通区域和多尺度标量结构。我们通过预训练的CNN和GAN风场超分辨率模型来刻画这一矛盾。逐点度量、瓶颈持续图（PD）距离和合并树（MT）距离更偏向CNN，而二阶Wasserstein PD距离则更偏向更锐利的GAN，这表明即使是同一拓扑描述符上的不同距离度量，也会奖励不同的特性。受这种分歧的启发，我们利用可微的拓扑启发辅助损失对预训练CNN进行微调，这些损失作用于标量速度、梯度幅值、软高速水平集和局部极大值，并采用固定对监督，即在地面真值持续对端点处（通过Topology ToolKit离线定位）约束预测值和持续性。一项针对16个微调……（原文摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出利用可微的拓扑启发辅助损失（标量速度、梯度幅值、软高速水平集、局部极大值）及固定持续对监督来微调预训练CNN，从而在风场超分辨率中弥合逐点重建损失与极值、连通区域等拓扑结构保真之间的矛盾。
en_tdlr: This paper fine-tunes a pretrained wind-field SR CNN with differentiable topology-inspired auxiliary losses and fixed persistence-pair supervision, reconciling pointwise reconstruction accuracy with the preservation of extrema, connected regions, and multiscale topological structure.
